name: Sidebar Tree
description: Accessible collapsible sidebar navigation tree with a live search filter, keyboard navigation, and animated expand and collapse with blur and fade.
contents: Search input with slash shortcut hint
Nested tree of links in groups with expand icons and current page marker
behavior: Branches expand and collapse with a grid height transition plus fade, blur and slide
Typing 3 or more characters filters the tree, highlights matches and expands their ancestors
Full keyboard support: arrows, Home, End, Enter, Space, type-ahead; slash focuses search, Escape clears it
editableByProps: Tree structure, labels, links and initial current item
Animation duration, fade, blur and slide distance
Search placeholder and label, accent, border, background and text colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change panel height or minimum width
needsCodeEdit.where: sidebar-root wrapper div style height and aside min-w-[250px]
search states rules for data-search-match in the style block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Adds a document keydown listener for the slash key to focus search, removed on unmount
Loads Noto Sans Mono through a Google Fonts import in the style block
